channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Zaza Pachulia | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Zaza Pachulia from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Russell Westbrook, Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr:

“I'm pretty sure Zaza (Pachulia) wants to come down and say hello to Russ (Westbrook).... They have a nice history together.”

Steve Kerr on Russell Westbrook, Zaza Pachulia, Apr 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
“Whether Nick’s foot pushed (Pachulia) down forward, we’ve seen it over and over andI don’t want to direct just him being a very, very dirty player strictly on him because a lot of dirty plays happen throughout the NBA but I mean when it’s consistently happening. Russ felt the same way. Paul (George) felt the same way.”

Kyrie Irving on Zaza Pachulia, Mar 1, 2018. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Paul George on Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Paul George on the Pachulia play:

“I’m going to take the Russ approach:Did you see what happened? You know Zaza, you know his history. Nobody pushed him. He aimed his fall ... He’s on the end of hurting a lot of guys.”

Paul George on Zaza Pachulia, Feb 25, 2018. Source: For The Win.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on Pachulia's fine:

“He’s going to be a little more careful with stuff like that, but it shouldn’t change the way he plays.”

Steve Kerr on Zaza Pachulia, Jan 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on Pachulia's All-Star surge:

“He's very popular in Georgia, we know that. ... I think it's great.”

Steve Kerr on Zaza Pachulia, Jan 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Warriors coachSteve Kerr on new center Zaza Pachulia:

“I think Zaza will be a coach in the NBA if he wants to go that route.”

Steve Kerr on Zaza Pachulia, Sep 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @ESPNSteinLine.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Raymond Felton, Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on the decision to replace Zaza Pachulia with Raymond Felton in the starting five:

“We changed the lineup just because we needed a shakeup. Everything is on the table game to game.”

Rick Carlisle on Raymond Felton, Zaza Pachulia, Mar 14, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Asked if Lee has earned more minutes and possibly a starting job at some point, Carlisle said:

“He's going to give you a great effort. But I think it's important that Pachulia is starting against those big bruisers to give us a physical presence in there. And from there, there are a lot of ways we can adjust. But it's pretty clear we have a bit of an eclectic group. We embrace that eclectic character, if you will. We've got to be who we are and play to our strength.”

Rick Carlisle on Zaza Pachulia, Mar 8, 2016. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: David West on Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Just one more time cuz I like it so much:@David West on Zaza Pachulia's elbows:

“It wasn't a big deal…I eat stuff like that – that's life.”

David West on Zaza Pachulia, Feb 6, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Mark Cuban on Almost-Star Zaza Pachulia:

“If I woulda known, I would have put him over the top. I didn't push it at all.”

Mark Cuban on Zaza Pachulia, Jan 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Devin Harris on Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Devin Harris on Zaza Pachulia:

“He kinda talks like Rocky, kinda looks like Rocky, always getting in the mix. We need that.”

Devin Harris on Zaza Pachulia, Jan 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.
